NYMPH_RELIC_NYMPH_RELIC.title: Count Spiritseeker
NYMPH_RELIC_NYMPH_RELIC.description: At the start of the run, gain one [gold]Inspiration[/gold]. After combat, there is a chance for one [gold]Inspiration[/gold] to drop.
NYMPH_RELIC_NYMPH_RELIC.inspirationSelec: You may choose one Inspiration card to play, or skip.
NYMPH_RELIC_NYMPH_RELIC.flavor: Albrecht von Xishou, Count of the Rosehorn Spire, promises to return with lost treasure and hidden wisdom.
NYMPH_RELIC_NYMPH_THOUGHTS_CATCHER.title: Thought Catcher
NYMPH_RELIC_NYMPH_THOUGHTS_CATCHER.descr: After combat, one [gold]Inspiration[/gold] is guaranteed to drop.
NYMPH_RELIC_NYMPH_THOUGHTS_CATCHER.inspi: You may choose one Inspiration card to play, or skip.
NYMPH_RELIC_NYMPH_THOUGHTS_CATCHER.flavo: These specially trained servants strike at once, turning ideas into tangible wealth.
NYMPH_RELIC_NYMPH_DISASTER_ORIGIN.title: Disaster Origin
NYMPH_RELIC_NYMPH_DISASTER_ORIGIN.descri: The first time you [gold]apply[/gold] [gold]Necrosis[/gold] each turn, apply [blue]1[/blue] additional layer.
NYMPH_RELIC_NYMPH_DISASTER_ORIGIN.flavor: The fall of the Sarkaz was already fated, so they demanded the whole world as their burial goods.
NYMPH_RELIC_NYMPH_SCALES_OF_AVARICE.desc: If your [gold]Inspiration Pile[/gold] contains at least [blue]3[/blue] Inspirations, gain [blue]15[/blue] Gold when entering a non-combat node.
NYMPH_RELIC_NYMPH_SCALES_OF_AVARICE.flav: The Revenant elder crushed the scales with his own soul and sealed his kin within his bones.
NYMPH_RELIC_NYMPH_BRIDGE_OF_KNOWLEDGE.de: The first time you [gold]Conceive[/gold] each turn, gain [blue]6[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
NYMPH_RELIC_NYMPH_BRIDGE_OF_KNOWLEDGE.fl: Between the shores of inspiration, knowledge built the first bridge.
NYMPH_RELIC_NYMPH_SOUL_BINDING_BONE.desc: Whenever you spend [blue]10[/blue] [gold]Thought[/gold] in a turn, gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
NYMPH_RELIC_NYMPH_SOUL_BINDING_BONE.flav: The bone that binds spirits also condenses spent thought into force.
NYMPH_RELIC_NYMPH_REVENANT_REMNANT.title: Revenant Remnant
NYMPH_RELIC_NYMPH_REVENANT_REMNANT.descr: The first card you [gold]Recreate[/gold] each combat gains [gold]Replay[/gold] [blue]1[/blue].
NYMPH_RELIC_NYMPH_REVENANT_REMNANT.flavo: To lose the body and become a wandering soul was a price some Sarkaz paid willingly for their people's future.
NYMPH_RELIC_NYMPH_SONG_OF_RESILIENT_SOUL: Whenever you play an [gold]Inspiration[/gold] card, increase your Max HP by [blue]3[/blue].
The song tells of a heart-dwelling demon who spoke every fear she sensed aloud, yet others still would not lower their guard.
NYMPH_RELIC_NYMPH_SLEEPING_KIN.title: Sleeping Kin
NYMPH_RELIC_NYMPH_SLEEPING_KIN.descripti: Upon pickup, choose a non-[gold]Ancient[/gold], non-[gold]Starter[/gold] relic you hold. This relic transforms into it.
NYMPH_RELIC_NYMPH_SLEEPING_KIN.flavor: Sleeping kin still breathe deep within your pack, waiting for a new form.
